messages:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick sync — CloudVendor co-marketing next week. Scope: marketplace listing, 45-min webinar, short launch blog + benchmark narrative. Need owners for landing page, webinar ops, inbound lead routing, and a runbook for post-launch follow-ups.

Ava (Marketing): I can own the landing page + blog draft. Will need hero copy, one customer quote, and benchmark highlights by EOD Tue.

Sam (Growth): I can do inbound routing. Plan: form -> HubSpot capture -> SFDC lead with tag 'cloudvendor-co'. Does that work? Also want to add UTM rules.

Diego (Sales Eng): I’ll prep integration demo evidence and a short troubleshooting doc for the webinar. Can we freeze the demo environment by Thu so I can do a dry run?

Olivia (Product Mkts): For benchmark narrative: let's focus on latency and cost-per-token for chat workloads vs their native offering. I can run the evals but need the dataset and target prompts. Prefer to surface 3 hero metrics and 1-2 qualitative notes about failure modes.

Priya (Partnerships): Yes on tags, Sam. Ava — hero copy example: "Make inference predictable & economical across clouds" — feel free to iterate. Diego — freeze demo by Thu confirmed.

Sam (Growth): Drafting routing snippet below — please review:  

```yaml
form_fields:
  - name: email
  - name: company
  - name: interest
  - name: utm_source
workflow:
  capture_to: hubspot
  sf_update: true
  sf_tag: cloudvendor-co
  notify: marketing@redwood.com
```

Ava (Marketing): LGTM Sam. I'll wire the form to that and add conversion pixels. Can someone share the single sign-off PR for the blog and the case quote?

Diego (Sales Eng): I'll get the demo checklist in the shared doc. Link: https://redwood-internal/drive/cv-demo (will upload by Wed).

Olivia (Product Mkts): Uploading benchmark deck to the same folder. Quick ask: do we publish raw numbers or normalized deltas? My preference is normalized deltas + an appendix with raw numbers.

Priya (Partnerships): Normalized deltas + appendix sounds good. Decision: webinar date set for next Thu 10am PT. Recording + on-demand will be in the marketplace listing.

Ava (Marketing): Timeline: landing page live Mon, blog + benchmarks Tue, webinar rehearsals Wed, webinar Thu. Assigning owners: landing page -> Ava, inbound routing -> Sam, demo + runbook -> Diego, benchmarks -> Olivia, comms + partner ops -> Priya.

Sam (Growth): Noted. I’ll post the webhook config once the form is ready. Also adding a small lead scoring rule: +50 if company domain matches CloudVendor reference list.

Priya (Partnerships): Can everyone drop final assets into the shared folder by Tue 5pm PT. I'll coordinate the partner-facing announcement copy and approval flow. :handshake:

cal-bot: Reminder set — Webinar rehearsal Wed 09:00 PT (invite sent).

Ava (Marketing): Quick Q re: benchmark narrative — any legal constraints on naming competitor features? Should we use generic phrasing or explicit calls?

Priya (Partnerships): Legal asked for neutral phrasing but allowed comparative performance statements if we have data to back them. Olivia, please cc legal on the deck.

Olivia (Product Mkts): Will do. CCing legal now.

Diego (Sales Eng): One more ops note — add fallback model routing in the runbook in case the dedicated flow hits capacity. Small code snippet:  

```json
{"route":"primary:model-a","fallback":"secondary:model-b","threshold_ms":1500}
```

Priya (Partnerships): Great catch. Adding that to the runbook checklist. Last ask: who will write the webinar CTA that points people to the marketplace listing?

Ava (Marketing): I’ll draft the CTA and the marketplace bullets. Will share for review by Tue morning.

Priya (Partnerships): Perfect. Thanks team — let’s reconvene Tue 11am for final pre-launch check. :rocket:
